title: Filter pushdown: a raising filter stays above a projection, but may cross a join
verdict: raising filters kept above projections; pushed into join inputs (to probe)
description: Undocumented. In the optimizer at v2.0.0, a filter that can raise (`CanThrow`) is not pushed through a projection: it stays on top (`pushdown_projection.cpp`). Only internal barrier expressions (`__internal_barrier`, for secure views) are held above every operator that can remove rows (`FilterPushdown::Rewrite`).

An inner join is turned into a cross product whose conditions and the filters above it are pushed to the side they reference, with no `CanThrow` test in `pushdown_inner_join.cpp` or `pushdown_left_join.cpp`. So `SELECT … FROM a JOIN b ON a.k = b.k WHERE 10 // a.x > 1` appears to evaluate `10 // a.x` on rows of `a` that find no partner, which the reference never evaluates. This is from reading the code: a probe must confirm it.

The other way round, DuckDB can raise less than the reference: a `LIMIT` stops the scan, so `WHERE s::INT = 10 LIMIT 1` does not raise on the unconvertible rows after the first match (DuckDB's test). That keeps the no-error guarantee.
reference: The reference evaluates an expression only on the rows its operator sees: a `CASE` branch on the rows that reach it, a filter's condition on the rows below it, a join condition on the pairs it forms. Its issue analysis (`Rel.HasIssue`, `SubstraitLean/Safety.lean`; docs/how-it-works.md) trusts the engine's evaluation order: `CASE` is lazy, `AND`/`OR` are not, and filter and join conditions may run before the filters below them. A plan `verify` reports error-free must run without error, so an engine that evaluates a raising expression on rows outside that model breaks the guarantee. sverify's DuckDB SQL writes a filter over a join as a `WHERE` over the join, which the optimizer is then free to push.

evidence.note: a filter that can throw stays on top of the projection
barrier filters are held above operators that remove rows
barriers mark expressions whose evaluation is observable
inner join: conditions and filters pushed to the sides, no CanThrow test
left join: filters on the left side pushed, no CanThrow test
LIMIT stops before the unconvertible rows

provenance.notes: Read, not replayed. Leads on main (paths at v2.0.0 to check): test/optimizer/pullup_join_expression_semantics.test, test/sql/optimizer/secure_view_fallible_functions.test, test/sql/window/window_scalarized_canthrow.test.
